hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/usr/bin/env bash set -euo pipefail
LOG_TS() { date +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z"; } log() { echo "[$(LOG_TS)] INFO $*" >&2; } warn() { echo "[$(LOG_TS)] WARN $*" >&2; } error() { echo "[$(LOG_TS)] ERROR $*" >&2; }
need() { command -v "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { error "Missing required command: $1"; exit 2; }; }
cleanup() { unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN; } trap cleanup EXIT
assume_role() { local role_arn="${ROLE_ARN:-arn:aws:iam::736265540791:role/dbgap-etl}" local session_name="${ROLE_SESSION_NAME:-s3-test}" local duration="${ASSUME_DURATION_SECONDS:-3600}"
log "Assuming role ${role_arn} (duration=${duration}s)" local assume_json assume_json="$(mktemp)"
aws sts assume-role \ --duration-seconds "$duration" \ --role-arn "$role_arn" \ --role-session-name "$session_name" \ > "$assume_json"
export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID="$(jq -r '.Credentials.AccessKeyId' "$assume_json")" AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY="$(jq -r '.Credentials.SecretAccessKey' "$assume_json")" AWS_SESSION_TOKEN="$(jq -r '.Credentials.SessionToken' "$assume_json")" rm -f "$assume_json"
log "Role assumed" }
s3_put_metadata() { local stdy_id="$1" abv_lc="$2" stdy_lc="$3" local_file="$4" local dst_prefix="s3://${S3_BUCKET}/general/hpds/javabin/${stdy_id}/metadata" local dst_obj="${dst_prefix}/${stdy_lc}_${abv_lc}_metadata.json"
log "Clearing existing JSON metadata under ${dst_prefix}/" aws s3 rm "${dst_prefix}/" --recursive --exclude "*" --include "*.json" --only-show-errors
log "Uploading metadata -> ${dst_obj}" aws s3 cp "$local_file" "$dst_obj" --only-show-errors }
# ----------------------------- # Prereqs + required env # ----------------------------- need aws need jq need csvcut need csvformat need tail need git
: "${managed_inputs:?managed_inputs must be set (s3://.../Managed_Inputs.csv or local path)}"
S3_BUCKET="${S3_BUCKET:-avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl}"
# Repo settings (override via env if you want) REPO_URL="${REPO_URL:-https://github.com/hms-dbmi/pic-sure-metadata-curation.git}" REPO_REF="${REPO_REF:-main}" # branch or tag REPO_DIR="${REPO_DIR:-pic-sure-metadata-curation}"
log "Bucket : ${S3_BUCKET}" log "Inputs src : ${managed_inputs}" log "Repo : ${REPO_URL} (${REPO_REF})" log "Repo dir : ${REPO_DIR}"
assume_role
# ----------------------------- # Pull managed inputs # ----------------------------- log "Downloading Managed_Inputs.csv" aws s3 cp "$managed_inputs" ./Managed_Inputs.csv --no-progress --only-show-errors
log "Building inputs.csv" csvcut -c "Study Abbreviated Name","Study Identifier","Study Type","Data is ready to process","Data Processed" \ Managed_Inputs.csv > inputs.csv
log "inputs.csv preview:" head -n 5 inputs.csv >&2 || true
# ----------------------------- # Ensure repo exists (clone/update) # ----------------------------- if [[ -d "$REPO_DIR/.git" ]]; then log "Repo already present; updating" git -C "$REPO_DIR" fetch --all --prune git -C "$REPO_DIR" checkout "$REPO_REF" git -C "$REPO_DIR" pull --ff-only else log "Cloning repo into ${REPO_DIR}" rm -rf "$REPO_DIR" git clone "$REPO_URL" "$REPO_DIR" git -C "$REPO_DIR" checkout "$REPO_REF" fi
cd "$REPO_DIR"
: > ../missing_metadata.txt
# ----------------------------- # Iterate rows # ----------------------------- tail -n +2 ../inputs.csv \ | csvformat -U 1 \ | while IFS=',' read -r abv_name stdy_id stdy_type data_ready data_processed; do abv_name="${abv_name%\"}"; abv_name="${abv_name#\"}" stdy_id="${stdy_id%\"}"; stdy_id="${stdy_id#\"}" stdy_type="${stdy_type%\"}"; stdy_type="${stdy_type#\"}" data_ready="${data_ready%\"}"; data_ready="${data_ready#\"}" data_processed="${data_processed%\"}"; data_processed="${data_processed#\"}"
abv_lc="$(printf '%s' "$abv_name" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')" stdy_lc="$(printf '%s' "$stdy_id" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')"
if [[ "${data_ready,,}" != "yes" ]] || [[ "${data_processed,,}" != "no" ]] || [[ "${stdy_type,,}" == "compliant" ]]; then log "Skipping ${stdy_id} (${abv_name}) [ready=${data_ready}, processed=${data_processed}, type=${stdy_type}]" continue fi
log "Processing ${stdy_id} (${abv_name})"
if [[ "$abv_lc" == "red_coral" ]]; then if [[ ! -d "redcoral/output" ]]; then warn "redcoral/output not found in repo; recording missing" echo "${abv_name} ${stdy_id}" >> ../missing_metadata.txt continue fi dst_prefix="s3://${S3_BUCKET}/general/hpds/javabin/${stdy_id}/metadata/" log "Clearing existing JSON metadata under ${dst_prefix}" aws s3 rm "${dst_prefix}" --recursive --exclude "*" --include "*.json" --only-show-errors log "Uploading redcoral/output/*.json -> ${dst_prefix}" aws s3 cp "redcoral/output/" "${dst_prefix}" \ --recursive --exclude "*" --include "*.json" --only-show-errors continue fi
mkdir -p "${abv_lc}/output" s3_src="s3://${S3_BUCKET}/${abv_lc}/decoded_data/${stdy_lc}_${abv_lc}_metadata.json" local_dst="${abv_lc}/output/${stdy_lc}_${abv_lc}_metadata.json"
log "Trying S3 decoded_data: ${s3_src}" if aws s3 cp "${s3_src}" "${local_dst}" --only-show-errors 2>/dev/null; then log "Metadata found on S3 for ${stdy_id} (${abv_name})" s3_put_metadata "$stdy_id" "$abv_lc" "$stdy_lc" "$local_dst" continue fi
if [[ -s "${local_dst}" ]]; then log "Metadata found in repo for ${stdy_id} (${abv_name})" s3_put_metadata "$stdy_id" "$abv_lc" "$stdy_lc" "$local_dst" continue fi
warn "Metadata missing for ${stdy_id} (${abv_name}); recording and continuing" echo "${abv_name} ${stdy_id}" >> ../missing_metadata.txt done
if [[ -s ../missing_metadata.txt ]]; then error "Some metadata files were missing. See missing_metadata.txt" exit 255 fi
log "Done"
